Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with SOURCE, is her jacket fully closed in EDITED?
node.criteria: Compare the same jacket's front closure in SOURCE and EDITED, accounting for the woman's changed orientation and the jacket's changed drape. Assess visible evidence that the front panels have moved together along the closure, not apparent displacement caused only by pose or a panel hanging outward. Full achievement requires the panels to meet with no visible opening along the closure. If the closure line is obscured or the images do not permit a reliable comparison, treat fulfillment as unresolved rather than inferring either progress or no progress.
node.binding: Judge only the requested change to the woman's jacket. Compare the closure line and front panels across SOURCE and EDITED while accounting for pose and drape: visible movement of the panels toward one another is partial progress if an opening remains; panels meeting with no visible opening is full closure. Do not count pose or apparent panel displacement alone as closure, and use unresolved when the comparison is obscured or insufficient.
node.endpoint: Her jacket is fully closed, with no visible opening along the closure.
node.necessity: This is the requested change and its complete endpoint.
node.zero_when: There is sufficient visibility to compare the same jacket's closure, and EDITED shows no visible movement of its front panels toward one another compared with SOURCE; it remains equally open or more open. Do not assign zero solely because a changed pose or obscured closure prevents comparison.
node.half_when: Visible evidence shows the front panels moving toward one another along the closure compared with SOURCE, but a visible opening remains; this is incomplete progress, not full closure. Do not count pose or outward drape alone as panel movement toward closure.
node.full_when: The front panels meet along the jacket closure and no visible opening remains. The closure line is sufficiently visible to establish this despite any change in pose or drape.

node_traces.evidence: The woman is facing mostly away in EDITED, and the jacket’s front closure is obscured by her orientation and the outward-hanging panel. SOURCE shows the jacket open, but the images do not provide reliable evidence that the panels moved together or that the jacket became fully closed.
